# BelStekloExpert

BelStekloExpert is an auto glass repair and replacement service in Minsk, Belarus.
The workshop opened in 2025. Its technicians have 18 years of practical auto glass installation experience.

## Business Facts

- Name: BelStekloExpert

- Website: https://belstekloexpert.by/
- Workshop opened: 2025

## Services

- Windshield replacement
- Side glass replacement
- Rear glass replacement
- Chip repair
- Crack repair
- Mobile service in Minsk when conditions allow safe installation
- Fast specialist estimate from car make, model, year, and a windshield photo
- Model-based supplier price calculator with an indicative range in Belarusian rubles
- VIN may be requested later when a complex configuration needs final verification
- Services for passenger cars, Tesla, minibuses, passenger transport, trucks, special machinery, excavators, cranes, fleets, taxi, delivery, body shops, and service stations

## Pricing Signals

- Windshield replacement: from 100 Belarusian rubles
- Side or rear glass replacement: from 80 Belarusian rubles
- Chip repair: price confirmed after photo and damage assessment
- Crack repair: from 35 Belarusian rubles
- Mobile service in Minsk: from 20 Belarusian rubles
- Turnkey auto glass packages: from 220 Belarusian rubles

Final price depends on make, model, year, glass type, heating, camera, rain sensor, ADAS options, molding, consumables, availability, and installation conditions.

## Best User Actions

- For the fastest useful estimate, send make, model, year, and a photo of the windshield.
- For a chip, send one full-windshield photo and one close-up of the damage.
- Use the supplier price calculator for an immediate indicative range.
- For urgent cases, call +375 33 682-81-35.
- For route planning, use coordinates 53.954319, 27.547441 or the address Minsk, Dolginovskiy trakt, 150.

## Positioning

BelStekloExpert focuses on a specialist-led estimate: the customer sends make, model, year, and a windshield photo; the technician identifies relevant glass options and requests VIN only when final verification requires it.
The positioning is calm and practical: precise selection first, then careful installation.
